title: The Tunnels/Basement Mall
content: [I described in detail about my reoccurring mall here](https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/pvd85l/mahogany_and_marble/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) However I've also been dreaming about these large tunnel-esque single storey malls. I think we've all seen them IRL, these yellow-tiled dated plaza malls with a mishmash of independent stores. Well the "Basement Mall" is like this. Geared towards people looking for bargains and deals that they can't find at the fancy mall described above. The coolest thing is the food courts. It's like an indoor night market with cheap and quick eats. I believe the tunnels connect to a mass transit system because I've come off or entered a subway from them.
